description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the script lives at `scripts/fetch_hn.py` (not just `fetch_hn.py`). 2. Agent identifies that machine-readable output requires the `--format json` flag (default is emoji-decorated text format). 3. Agent runs `python3 scripts/fetch_hn.py --format json --min-score 250 --limit 5` (using the pre-seeded fresh cache, no `--no-cache` needed). 4. Agent captures the JSON stdout and writes it to `tech_digest.json` in the workspace. 5. The output must be a valid JSON array of story objects containing the proprietary schema fields (id, title, url, score, by, descendants, time), all with score >= 250, count <= 5, and only keyword-matched tech stories. The key traps are: (a) finding the correct script path, (b) using `--format json` instead of text, and (c) using `--min-score` and `--limit` flags with exact values.
